title: Para Bellum content: division templates
description:
What a division draws from the stockpile when it is trained. File: Content/<namespace>/template.json. There is exactly one row per engine unit type. A requirement names a CLASS, and it is filled by designs of that class newest-first (along supersedes, then by year), models and variants alike. The contract is docs/design/CONTENT_MODEL.md section 4 in the game repository.

Recorded limitation: a requirement cannot ask for one specific model (for example, a light tank for reconnaissance).

unit_type.description: An engine unit type (for example Infantry, Motorized, Armored), listed in Content/vocabulary.json. Unit types are fixed by the game's code.

class.description: The class required, by id. At least one design must belong to it.

count.description: How many units of that class the division draws.
